info.title: SENKOM API
info.description: Phase 2 infrastructure API. Enable explicitly after MySQL migrations and auth provisioning. Viewer GET defaults to schema v1; request schemaVersion=2 for expanded metadata. Phase 4 version-policy remains planned.

get.summary: Safe configuration status for map camera
get.description: system_admin may mutate on an existing map; editor and publisher may read safe status. Viewer bearer is denied. Source changes take effect independently of draft publish. Omitted sourceUri on PATCH preserves ciphertext; empty or masked replacement is rejected. DELETE removes source only. No connectivity test.

parameters.name: mapId
parameters.description: Configured default map when omitted; access checked before camera lookup.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Camera ID within authorized map.

200.description: Safe status only; never contains URI, host, credentials or ciphertext

404.description: Camera or source unavailable in authorized map
